changelog:
- Initial release of gigma-design, an AI-powered design tool with a fully editable canvas and 19 MCP tools.
- Enables creating, editing, and exporting social graphics, thumbnails, banners, and batch designs with real-time control.
- Supports full element manipulation (add, update, mask, reorder, delete) and high-res PNG export up to 3x.
- Streamlines workflow with project management, batch creation, and instant screenshot preview features.
- Designed as a full read/write alternative to Figma MCP’s screenshot-only workflow.
